description: Guide for configuring TABG server templates, loadouts, spawns, curses, and match settings

starterPack.description: TheStarterPack.txt is a key=value config file that controls match mechanics, loadouts, and spawn settings.

WinCondition.description: How the match ends. Default=last alive, KillsToWin=kill count, Debug=timer only

KillsToWin.description: Number of kills to win in KillsToWin mode

ForceKillAtStart.description: Force kill players out of trucks at match start. Required for deathmatch/gungame modes.

ItemsGiven.description: Items given to all players. Format: id:qty,id:qty

HealOnKillAmount.description: Percentage of HP healed on kill

CanGoDown.description: Whether team members go down or respawn instantly

CanLockOut.description: Whether players can be locked out

CustomSpawnPoint.description: Custom spawn coordinates x,y,z (used when ValidSpawnPoints contains 6)

PercentOfVotes.description: Required percent of votes to start

MinNumberOfPlayers.description: Required number of players to start

TimeToStart.description: Seconds after voting for match to begin

loadoutFormats.reverseGunGame: ReverseGunGame/Name:100%itemId:qty/ (advances on death, needs 2 empty loadouts at start)
loadoutFormats.keepInventory: KeepInventory/Name:100%itemId:qty/ (items persist through death, do NOT combine with GunGame)

loadoutCurses.description: Set in plugin config as 'LoadoutCurses = curseIds/curseIds/...'
loadoutCurses.format: Comma-separated curse IDs per loadout, loadouts separated by /
loadoutCurses.example: 2,4/8,14 = curses 2+4 on loadout 1, curses 8+14 on loadout 2. Loadouts after final / get no curses.

ringSettings.description: In game_settings.txt, RingSizes and RingSpeeds are arrays of three values
